payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedily selects rightmost occurrences of required digits to move to the last two positions for divisibility by 25, minimizing total adjacent swaps with leading-zero checks.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over possible endings (00,25,50,75), computing minimal swaps by finding the nearest needed digits from the right. This greedy choice is optimal as moving a closer digit yields fewer swaps, fitting an exchange argument.
